The suite now includes FsCheck properties that vary and shrink scanner argument inputs, and the publish workflow runs the suite before packing a release. These properties were first added after 5.17.0; no retrospective fuzzing claim is made. The 78.53% branch rate alone would not satisfy the alternative 80%-branch-coverage route.

Project-produced code is managed C#; this repository does not produce a C/C++ or other memory-unsafe native component. Native implementations inside the .NET runtime are upstream dependencies, not code produced here.
xUnit and FsCheck properties make explicit assertions about results, invariants and errors. Failures include replay/shrunk-input information and fail the normal suite.

All 5,950 net10.0 tests passed. No confirmed exploitable medium-or-higher issue from dynamic tests remains; the first run exposed a macOS temporary-path assertion mismatch and passed using the canonical /private/tmp directory.
